## About This Run

This page presents results from running the full BERTopic pipeline on the entire collection. Comparing it against the two 10% samples shows which themes are stable across the full corpus and which emerged only in specific subsets of documents.

To reproduce this run, use `scripts/run_bertopic_sample.py` from the [GitHub repository](https://github.com/jinghanlib/topic-modeling-slave-narratives) with `--sample-frac 1.0`. The same setup steps from the [Hands-On Exercise](02_hands_on_exercise.qmd) apply — the only difference is the sample fraction flag and a longer run time.

```text
Sample fraction: 100%
Documents:       294
Chunks:          16,729
Topics found:    439
```

All CSV files and HTML visualizations for this run are in the repository under:

```text
outputs/bertopic_full_nomic_sensitive_lemmatized/
  topic_review_table.csv
  topic_labels_llm.csv
  topic_assignments.csv    ← local only, too large to host on the site
  topic_info.csv
  visualizations/          ← 4 BERTopic charts (open in browser)
  metadata_visualizations/  ← 5 metadata charts (open in browser)
```

With 294 documents, the model finds far more topics than any single 10% sample — including many narrow topics tied to specific documents or authors. Some topics are broad recurring themes; others are very specific to a single narrative. The same note about similar labels applies: multiple topics with similar names (such as several "Whipping and Plantation Punishment" clusters) are distinct groups that the model kept separate based on differences in vocabulary and context.

## Download the Results

```{=html}
<p>
  <a class="btn btn-primary" href="../outputs/bertopic_full_nomic_sensitive_lemmatized/topic_review_table.csv" download>Download topic review table</a>
  <a class="btn btn-outline-primary" href="../outputs/bertopic_full_nomic_sensitive_lemmatized/topic_labels_llm.csv" download>Download topic labels</a>
  <a class="btn btn-outline-primary" href="../outputs/bertopic_full_nomic_sensitive_lemmatized/topic_info.csv" download>Download topic info</a>
</p>
```

`topic_assignments.csv` for the full collection is too large to host on the site (over 100 MB). It is available locally after running the pipeline — see the folder path above.

The scripts used to produce these results are in the `scripts/` folder of the [GitHub repository](https://github.com/jinghanlib/topic-modeling-slave-narratives):

- `run_bertopic_sample.py` — runs the full pipeline for any sample size or the complete collection
- `visualize_topic_metadata.py` — generates the review table and all metadata visualizations

To reproduce the full collection run, use `--sample-frac 1.0 --output-dir outputs/bertopic_full_nomic_sensitive_lemmatized` with the same embedding and labeling flags shown in the [Hands-On Exercise](02_hands_on_exercise.qmd).
